rca_of_issue: Bug: Admin tap on admin-signout-btn leaves user on /admin showing 'Admin access required'. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx signOut() only performs `await api('/auth/logout')`, `setToken(null)`, `setUser(null)` — no router.replace. The admin.tsx guard (line 59) then renders 'Admin access required' because user is null but the route is still /admin. index.tsx would route null → /(auth)/welcome, but index.tsx is not the mounted route. Mitigation: append `router.replace('/(auth)/welcome')` inside signOut (using `useRouter` at provider scope or accepting a router from the caller), or wrap the onPress in admin.tsx: `onPress={async () => { await signOut(); router.replace('/(auth)/welcome'); }}`. The second option is safer because auth.tsx doesn't currently import expo-router. Reproduction: sign in as admin → land on /admin → tap admin-signout-btn → observe URL stays /admin and 'Admin access required' red text shows.
